boxes.reason: No 3D driver exists here. NVIDIA never shipped a 32-bit Turing driver, and id Tech 3 has no software renderer. Re-including the box needs 64-bit Win7 SP1+ or a card with a 32-bit Win7 driver. The compat DB row 'verified 1920x1080' predates the 2026-10-26 reinstall and is stale.

summary: PASS: 8 of 8 applicable boxes (.110 .123 .124 .133 .143 .171 .184 .240) were re-verified at 15:57-15:58 in ONE Team Arena FFA game on q3ta-server 192.168.1.132:27962 (mpteam1). Proof for each box: rcon status names it with its own IP (8 Fleet rows, 0 bots); 12 s tcpdump shows 368-1485 packets to :27962 from each; a fresh frame shows the TA scoreboard with all 8 names (.124: fbshot of live 3D at 43 fps); a UIKEY F5 sent after a foreground=ioquake3 check produced 'say: FleetNNN: FleetNNN in game' in server.log. PIDs match launch: no relaunch, no drop, no map change since line 24741. .186 and .243 are NA (no 32-bit Turing driver / gated and not installed), re-checked live. Closed with lanparty kill: all 8 closed by WM_CLOSE, none forced. PROCLIST shows no ioquake3.x86.exe/quake3.exe and no crash dialogs. All 8 are at their desktop modes, and the server holds only its 3 fill bots.
issues: The orchestrator's command 'lanparty.py kill --game Quake3-TeamArena' fails: 'error: unrecognized arguments: --game'. The CLI takes the game as a POSITIONAL argument ('lanparty.py kill Quake3-TeamArena --out ...'). That form was used and works.

q3ta-server now holds only its 3 fill bots (Gaunt, Biker, Ursula) on mpteam1. With the retail 1.32 qagame.qvm they will reach fraglimit and freeze at intermission until a human is ready, so the next Team Arena round must keep the prelaunch 'rcon map mpteam1' (lanparty does this).

After an rcon map change, the recipe's intermission test (grep '^(Exit:|Server: )' server.log | tail -1) is misleading. ioq3 sends the rcon command's output to the rcon reply, so no 'Server: mpteam1' line is logged. Use rcon status, or Kill: lines after the last Exit:.
Cosmetic: the TA client scoreboard footer reads 'Fraglimit: 20' while the server and .124's HUD read 25.
.171 joins with rate 25000 from a stray 2004 missionpack q3config.cfg in the install tree. It is harmless on the LAN; leftover per-box state, since GAMESYNC never deletes.

After close, .143 sits at 1280x1024x32@60. That matches its persisted 1280x1024. It has no EDID, so no refresh is claimed, and ioquake3 restores the registry mode on exit. Noted only, not a fault. Every other box is at its usual desktop mode (.110 1600x1200@85, .123 1280x1024@100, .124 1280x1024@85, .133/.171 1280x1024@85, .184 1024x768@85, .240 1920x1080@60).
